description: MEASURED audit of the canonical 5-metal MetalCytoTox cohort build: frequency of the Wf-A93 metal-placement push-cap hit, and the element distribution of the metal-donor bonds the builder writes (which is what the donor-set extension must stay bit-exact against).
scope: Wf-A93 bonded placement cap + Wf-A94 donor-set unification
interpretation: The push cap fires on 0.50% of clouds (2/399), so 'could not clear the ligand' is a rare tail rather than a silent failure mode. Every builder-written metal bond is N/O/S/P, i.e. already inside the pre-Wf-A94 donor set: 0 of 1,894 bond LABELS change. The halide extension does flip 8 of 597,661 pair-feature columns (7/399 clouds, 1.3e-5), because a ligand halide within 3.5 A of the metal is now flagged dative. That is the intended effect, and it is small enough that no archived result moves materially.
verdict: CAP RATE MEASURED (0.50%); DONOR EXTENSION BIT-EXACT ON THE CANONICAL COHORT
